title: Poor
summary: A page that maximises its own Cumulative Layout Shift and wears the failing Core Web Vitals grade Google hands it for being alive.
mechanism: PerformanceObserver on 'layout-shift' (W3C Layout Instability API) sums real CLS from in-flow blocks jolted client-side; prefers-reduced-motion freezes it to score 0 and be rated GOOD.
references: Google Core Web Vitals / Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS)
y-a-v-a manifesto: 'There is no art piece, only change'
